id.description: The unique identifier for the beneficiary

active.description: Shows whether the payee is currently active or not

reference.description: The reference attached to the beneficiary

iban.description: For cash accounts. Populated with the full IBAN number.

pan.description: For card accounts. Populated with the Primary Account Number.

providerAccountId.description: The provider account ID the beneficiary belongs to

providerBeneficiaryId.description: The provider beneficiary ID for the beneficiary

accountId.description: The Moneyhub account ID that the beneficiary belongs to

postalAddress.description: Additional postal address information for the beneficiary agent, only retrieved using **beneficiaries_detail:read** scope

createdAt.description: The date at which the beneficiary was added.

modifiedAt.description: The date at which the beneficiary was added.
